name: CLI continuation services
logic_name: Real text clipboard, bounded workspace path snapshot, and persisted preferences

test_list.description: Text read and copy are queued with caller generation; stale generations are retired and OS clipboard is not touched by tests.
Text over 1 MiB is rejected and image clipboard content is never requested.
A bounded glob snapshot reports truncation and stale generation results are retired.
Snapshot paths respect ignore rules, secret exclusions, and symlink containment provided by polaris-tools-builtin.
Runtime preference overlays are memory-only; explicit persistence uses only the global config owner.
Cycling a setting changes only the runtime override; explicit apply persists one selected field to Dirs.global and leaves other overrides active.
The settings helper returns six real value rows, wraps selection, and marks exactly the selected row.
Render fixtures and demo settings constructed from snapshots reject apply_selection before writing global config.
Explicit preference persistence is queued to a bounded worker and returns a generation-tagged result to nonblocking polling.
Canceled or superseded save results are discarded; memory-only settings cannot persist through the worker.
An untouched settings selection does not write a runtime CLI override to global preferences.
A cycled setting can be explicitly saved while unrelated CLI overrides remain memory-only.
Empty text writes are rejected before queueing so the native clipboard backend cannot clear other clipboard formats.
A spawned clipboard child with a missing stdout pipe is killed and waited before returning an error.
